title: 第一卷 第8章 木屋排名
slug: 木屋求生一天一个神级特性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

闭上眼睛，感受着这难得的舒适。

外面的各种嘶吼声音，似乎也少了不少。

一边泡脚，一边又

快速地浏览着交易平台上面的各种东西。

这第一天时间，还真是没有什么好货。

有些奇葩连自己的粑粑都挂了上去的。

还有卖视频的，简直不堪入目。

不过还是找到了好东西。

一把弓箭！

虽然只是一把木弓，但好歹是一个远距离的攻击武器。

在这个满是丧尸的世界，远程的武器，代表着那你能够多点活着的机会。

看了一下价格，五十块木板。

其实也差不多。

木弓这种东西，只要有好的材料，简易制作台也能够制造出来。

唯一的不足就是弓弦不好弄。

“兄弟，五块橡胶交换你的弓！”

秦龙给交易方发了一个私信。

暂时没回，没关系，再看别的东西。

秦龙看到了什么！

手枪通用子弹10发！

竟然还有这种东西。

秦龙还以为武器都是冷兵器。

现在冷不丁冒出个手枪通用子弹，着实有点惊讶更是狂喜。

在原来的蓝星之上，秦龙可是在特殊的神秘部门。

枪，对他来说是再熟练不过了！

如果有了枪械这种热武器，那对付起丧尸来，绝对事半功倍！

只可惜，交易平台里面，根本没有枪械，只有这子弹！

不过有子弹的出现，那么枪械还会远吗。

这10发手枪通用子弹，卖家要一百块木板！

而且此时，区域聊天频道上面，似乎也在讨论这个子弹的事情！

“你们看到那10发通用子弹没有。”

“早就看到了，可惜没有手枪，只能是个摆设。”

“脑残，这是一个信号，会有热武器的出现！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Close your eyes and feel this rare comfort.

The various roaring sounds outside seemed to be reduced a lot.

While soaking my feet, I

Quickly browse the various things on the trading platform.

On this first day, there really wasn’t any good stuff.

Some weird ones even have their own daddy hanging up.

There are also people selling videos, which are simply unsightly.

Still found something good though.

A bow and arrow!

Although it is just a wooden bow, it is a long-range attack weapon.

In this world full of zombies, long-range weapons represent more chances for you to stay alive.

I looked at the price, fifty boards.

In fact, it's almost the same.

Things like wooden bows can be made on a simple crafting table as long as they have good materials.

The only drawback is that the bow string is difficult to handle.

"Brother, five pieces of rubber in exchange for your bow!"

Qin Long sent a private message to the transaction party.

No reply yet, that’s okay, let’s look at something else.

What did Qin Long see?

10 rounds of universal bullets for pistols!

There is such a thing.

Qin Long thought the weapons were all cold weapons.

Now, a universal bullet for a pistol appears out of nowhere. I am actually a little surprised and even more ecstatic.

On the original Blue Star, Qin Long was in a special mysterious department.

He couldn't be more skilled with a gun!

If you have hot weapons like firearms, you can definitely deal with zombies with twice the result with half the effort!

It's a pity that there are no firearms at all in the trading platform, only these bullets!

But with the appearance of bullets, will guns be far away?

For these 10 general-purpose bullets for pistols, the seller wants one hundred wooden boards!

And at this time, it seems that this bullet is also being discussed on the regional chat channel!

"Did you see those 10 rounds of universal bullets?"

"I've seen it a long time ago, but it's a pity that it doesn't have a pistol, it can only be a decoration."

"Brainless, this is a signal that thermal weapons will appear!"
